oil.when: 2005 (CHANGE OIL light, reset with the accelerator pedal)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON but do not start the engine.
Slowly press the accelerator pedal all the way down and release it three times within five seconds.
The reset is done when chimes sound and the CHANGE OIL light goes out.
Turn the key to OFF. If the light comes back on at the next start, or no chime sounded, repeat the steps.

notes: If the oil life system is ever reset by accident, change the oil within 3,000 miles of the last change.
